en.name: Mustard, ground
en.summary: Ground mustard keeps 6 months in a cool, dark cupboard, or 1–2 years in the freezer. Six months is short for a spice, and there is a reason: the heat in mustard comes from an enzyme reaction that a stale, damp or old powder no longer performs properly.
en.pantry: 6 months in an airtight jar, cool, dark and dry. Ground mustard is unusual among spices in that its pungency is not sitting in the powder waiting to be released — it is created when the powder meets cold water and an enzyme acts on the compounds in the seed. That machinery degrades with age and with any moisture that reaches the jar, so old mustard powder mixes up flat and merely bitter rather than hot. Nothing is spoiling; the reaction is simply weaker.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for ground mustard. The fridge is humid and the powder is hygroscopic, and moisture is precisely what starts the enzyme reaction prematurely inside the jar. That leaves you with a powder that has already used up its heat before it reaches the bowl. Keep it dry in a cupboard, or use the freezer, which has a published figure behind it.
en.freezer: 1–2 years in the freezer, sealed airtight. This is the one cold option with a published figure, and it is worth using if you buy mustard powder in any quantity — it roughly triples the useful life. Portion it so you are not opening a large bag repeatedly, and let each portion come to room temperature inside its container before opening, so condensation does not reach the powder.
en.thawing: Let the sealed container come fully to room temperature before opening, then use the powder dry. Do not refreeze a portion that has been out.
spoilage: A mix that tastes bitter but not hot, meaning the enzyme reaction has faded.
Caking into hard lumps, which means moisture has got in.
Little or no bite in the nose when freshly mixed with cold water.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got damp.
tips: Mix with cold water, not hot — heat destroys the enzyme before it works.
Let a fresh mix stand ten minutes to develop, then add any acid; vinegar early locks the heat in low.
Buy small jars; six months goes quickly on a spice rack.
Freeze a large bag in portions rather than keeping it all in the cupboard.

faq.q: How long does ground mustard keep?
faq.a: 6 months in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard, or 1–2 years in the freezer.

faq.q: Why does ground mustard keep less well than other spices?
faq.a: Its heat is produced by an enzyme reaction when the powder meets water, and that reaction weakens with age and moisture. Old powder mixes up flat rather than hot.
Yes, 1–2 years sealed airtight. Portion it, and let each portion warm to room temperature inside its container before opening.

zh.name: 黃芥末粉
zh.summary: 黃芥末粉放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 6 個月，冷凍則是 1～2 年。六個月對一種香料來說偏短，而這是有原因的：芥末的嗆辣來自一個酵素反應，而放久、受潮的粉已經無法好好執行這個反應。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月。黃芥末粉在香料裡很特別：它的嗆度並不是躺在粉裡等著被釋放，而是在粉遇到冷水、酵素作用於種子裡的成分時「被製造出來」的。這套機制會隨著時間與任何跑進罐子的水氣而退化，所以放久的芥末粉調出來只是平板的苦，而不是嗆。這不是腐敗，只是反應變弱了。
zh.fridge: 黃芥末粉沒有公布的冷藏期限。冰箱潮濕，而這種粉又極會吸濕；而水氣正是會在罐子裡提前啟動那個酵素反應的東西，等於嗆度在還沒進到碗裡之前就先耗掉了。請放乾燥的櫥櫃，或改用冷凍——冷凍是有公開數字支持的。
zh.freezer: 密封冷凍 1～2 年。這是唯一有公開數字的低溫選項；如果你買的量比較大，很值得這麼做，因為它大約把可用壽命拉長三倍。請分裝，免得反覆打開一大包；每一小份也要連著容器回到室溫再打開，免得結露碰到粉。
zh.thawing: 讓密封容器完全回到室溫再打開，然後乾燥使用。取出過的那一份不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 調出來只有苦味而不嗆，代表酵素反應已經退化。
結成硬塊，代表水氣跑進去了。
剛用冷水調好時，鼻腔幾乎沒有那股衝勁。
受潮的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 用冷水調，不要用熱水——高溫會在酵素作用前就把它破壞掉。
調好靜置十分鐘讓嗆度發展出來，之後再加酸；太早加醋會把辣度鎖在很低的程度。
買小罐；六個月在香料架上過得很快。
大包裝分裝冷凍，不要整包放在櫥櫃。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃 6 個月，或冷凍 1～2 年。

faq.q: 為什麼芥末粉比其他香料不耐放？
faq.a: 它的嗆度是粉遇水時由酵素反應產生的，而這個反應會隨時間與濕氣變弱。放久的粉調出來平板而不嗆。
可以，密封冷凍 1～2 年。請分裝，並讓每一小份連著容器回到室溫再打開。
